_comment: The status Policies of a real hub (ACM 2.16), read with oc get on 2026-10-27, with only the kubectl last-applied-configuration annotation dropped: the roots ai-grid-catalog-status (placed on the ingress and combined clusters, here site-a) and ai-grid-models-status (inference and combined: site-a and site-b), and each cluster's copy, ai-grid-policies.<policy> in the cluster's namespace. site-a is a combined cluster and site-b an inference cluster, so site-b has no copy of ai-grid-catalog-status.
